title: QQ Pets Reborn with an AI Brain: Integrated with Tencent Hy3 Large Model, This Time It Will Actually Respond to You
excerpt: Tencent has officially announced that QQ Pets, which carry the nostalgic memories of a generation, will return in a new form. This upgrade not only fully 3D-ize
content_html:
Tencent has officially announced that QQ Pets, which carry the nostalgic memories of a generation, will return in a new form. This upgrade not only fully 3D-izes the appearance and gives it a soft, tactile texture, but also embeds Tencent's self-developed Hy3 large model into the pet's little brain, giving this virtual companion the ability to respond actively.

The pet-raising gameplay retains classic mechanics such as feeding, bathing, and working, while being comprehensively upgraded - you can choose a pet with various appearances and personalities, whether a drama queen or a clingy type, each with its own character. The pets will also appear in core QQ scenarios such as the contact list and chat window, always by your side.

Interactions between friends have also been refreshed: you can visit your friend's home, feed or bathe their pet, and even step on the spark. Tencent stated that users can even raise their own pets to become top stars, experiencing a more immersive breeding experience.

29.5 billion parameter large model drives, competing directly with flagship models

The Hy3 model that brings soul to QQ Pets was officially open-sourced on July 6th, using a MoE (Mixture of Experts) architecture, with a total of 29.5 billion parameters, 21 billion activated parameters, and a maximum context length of 256K. In key tasks such as reasoning, intelligent agents, and long contexts, Hy3 achieves results comparable to flagship models with 2 to 5 times the parameter scale. Installing a large model of this scale into QQ Pets means that every time you feed or interact with your pet, there is top-tier AI power driving it behind the scenes. QQ Pets may no longer just be a nostalgic symbol of the digital age, but is becoming a clever entry point for AI to enter the daily lives of hundreds of millions of users.

content_html_zh:
腾讯正式宣布，承载一代人怀旧记忆的QQ宠物将以全新形态回归。 此次升级不仅将外观完全3D化，赋予其柔软的触感质感，还将腾讯自主研发的Hy3大模型嵌入到宠物的小大脑中，让这个虚拟伴侣拥有主动反应的能力。

宠物养成玩法在保留喂食、洗澡、干活等经典玩法的同时，全面升级——你可以选择各种外貌和性格的宠物，无论是戏精型还是粘人型，各有各的性格。 宠物也会出现在联系人列表、聊天窗口等QQ核心场景中，时刻陪伴在你身边。

朋友之间的互动也焕然一新：你可以拜访朋友的家，给他们的宠物喂食或洗澡，甚至踩火花。 腾讯表示，用户甚至可以饲养自己的宠物成为顶级明星，体验更身临其境的饲养体验。

295亿参数大模型驱动，与旗舰模型直接竞争

为QQ宠物带来灵魂的Hy3模型于7月6日正式开源，采用MoE（Mixture of Experts）架构，参数总数295亿个，激活参数210亿个，最大上下文长度256K。 在推理、智能代理和长上下文等关键任务中，Hy3 在参数规模为 2 至 5 倍的情况下取得了与旗舰模型相当的结果。 在QQ宠物中安装如此规模的大型模型，意味着每次你给宠物喂食或与宠物互动时，都有顶级的AI力量在幕后驱动它。 QQ宠物或许不再只是数字时代的怀旧象征，而正在成为AI走进亿万用户日常生活的一个巧妙切入点。
